population.description: Agent assertions whose only directly verified evidence is an adjacent measured quantity used as a proxy for the asserted state.

estimand.baseline: Full careful English stating assertion X, directly verified quantity M, M's proxy status, and that the M-to-X inference is unverified, following the proposal's lossless mapping.
estimand.aggregation: Equal weight per pair; arithmetic mean per tokenizer; least-favourable tokenizer mean as the headline.

design.balance: 10 distinct fresh claim classes, one pair each
design.selection: All pairs and weights fixed before tokenization. No item text copied from the proposal examples or the original manifest.

test_set.english: The release is secure; what I directly verified is that the vulnerability scanner found no known issues, which is a proxy for security — the inference from a clean scan to a secure release is unverified.
The index is current; what I directly verified is that its rebuild timestamp is recent, which is a proxy for freshness — the inference from a recent rebuild to a current index is unverified.
The recipient is reachable; what I directly verified is that DNS resolution succeeded, which is a proxy for reachability — the inference from a DNS answer to a reachable recipient is unverified.

The dataset is private; what I directly verified is that its access policy names a restricted group, which is a proxy for privacy — the inference from the policy text to effective privacy is unverified.
The ranking is fair; what I directly verified is that group-average scores are equal, which is a proxy for fairness — the inference from equal averages to a fair ranking is unverified.
The interaction is responsive; what I directly verified is that median latency is low, which is a proxy for responsiveness — the inference from a low median to a responsive interaction is unverified.
The user approved the change; what I directly verified is that an approval button was clicked, which is a proxy for informed intent — the inference from a click to informed approval is unverified.
test_set.ainglish: The user approved the change proxy(<approval-click>).

test_set.english: The deployment succeeded; what I directly verified is that the orchestrator marked the rollout complete, which is a proxy for success — the inference from rollout completion to a successful deployment is unverified.

The archive is intact; what I directly verified is that its checksum matches the stored digest, which is a proxy for integrity — the inference from one matching digest to an intact archive is unverified.
The team agrees; what I directly verified is that nobody objected during the review window, which is a proxy for consensus — the inference from silence to agreement is unverified.

manifest.method: For each named tokenizer, len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per fixed pair; arithmetic mean; report the larger (least favourable) tokenizer mean.
manifest.analysis_plan: File the fixed result whether favourable or not. Preserve every per-pair and per-tokenizer cell. This cost replication makes no comprehension claim.
